correctness.rationale: Qutrit Werner–Holevo output decomposition has six off-diagonal eigenvalues λ_i/4 (multiplicity 2 each) and three diagonal-block eigenvalues γ_j/4 from x³−2x²+x−4e₃. Newton recurrence gives exact fifth moment 4+10e₂²−10e₂e₃−10e₂+70e₃. Maclaurin bounds e₃≤(e₂/3)^(3/2); the stated factorization has sign on u∈[0,1/3] and equality only at u=1/3. Independently checked uniform eigenvalues yield 43/10368 and violation ratio fifth power 86/81. The actual verifier script was inspected but was not used as sole evidence. Equality requires uniform Schmidt coefficients.

originality.rationale: Werner–Holevo 2002 explicitly asserted from PLOTS that the p=5 maximizer is at the maximally entangled Schmidt center, and the witness output formula yields the exact center fifth moment by substitution. Thus optimizer location and witness value are antecedents, not new discoveries. The original paper gives no rigorous full-simplex positivity inequality or equality-case proof; current new contribution is an exact rigorous GLOBAL certificate and uniqueness. Novelty is narrowly this proof rather than first statement of optimizer. Best-of-knowledge O survives with high prior-coverage risk.
